title: Yandex Q.E.D. Math Challenge 2018
text:
Yandex Annual Q.E.D Math Challenge March 24th, 2018 Registration & Practice test: https://yandex.com/math

Yandex is excited to welcome global math enthusiasts to compete in its annual Quod Erat Demonstrandum (Q.E.D.) math challenge. Historically open to Russian contestants, this year we welcome people around the world to test and develop their math and logic skills in the Yandex 60-minute Q.E.D on March 24th, 2018.

Contest Details:

  • Register online at https://yandex.com/math through Yandex email or social media
  • Take the available practice test to prepare
  • Enter the contest by taking the single attempt 60-minute test on March 24th, 2018

Contestant qualifications:

  • Background in mathematics (Education level ranges: secondary, university, professional)
  • Ability to solve equations with one unknown variable (( x + 5 = 15. x = 15)
  • Ability to solve logic problems
  • Analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Test does not require contestants to have memorized any math formulas
